subject: mathematik

progressAccounting.rule: The seven stable KEEP/KEEP decisions, seven accepted text revisions, and four bounded direct-requires corrections are adjudication decisions only. Strict progress remains zero until exact-current resolutions, positive-understanding-evidence-v2, integration, and all required gates pass.

contractNoteDe: Die Fachadjudikation bewahrt sieben fachlich tragfähige KEEP/KEEP-Ziele mitsamt ihrem geprüften direkten und rückwärtigen Beziehungskontext unverändert, akzeptiert sieben eng begrenzte bilinguale Präzisierungen und korrigiert ausschließlich vier belegte direkte requires-Kontexte. Die fehlerhaften BLOCK-Begründungen für effe43eb und fa02cf14 werden wegen nachgewiesener eigener Quellenbindung und bestätigter Atomizität verworfen; beide Ziele bleiben erhalten. Alle vorhandenen Nano-Banana-Pro-Bildbytes bleiben unverändert. Die zwölf nicht unmittelbar stabilen Ziele werden nach Integration beziehungsweise bestätigter Beibehaltung erneut zweifach blind geprüft. Bis zu gültigen Resolutionen, positiven Evidence-V2-Profilen und grünen Layer-A-Gates entsteht kein zusätzlicher strikter Fortschritt.
contractNoteEn: The subject adjudication preserves seven sound KEEP/KEEP goals together with their reviewed direct and reverse relationship context, accepts seven tightly bounded bilingual clarifications, and corrects exactly four evidenced direct-requires contexts. The erroneous BLOCK rationales for effe43eb and fa02cf14 are rejected because both goals have independent source binding and confirmed atomicity; both goals are retained. All existing Nano Banana Pro image bytes remain unchanged. The twelve goals that are not immediately stable receive two fresh blind reviews after integration or confirmed retention. No additional strict progress is claimed before valid resolutions, positive Evidence V2 profiles, and green Layer-A gates.

topologyDecisions.rationale: The inherited list is not an individually justified progression. Calculus, orientation, and angle-computation prerequisites are either foreign or already transitively represented; the direct vector foundation remains.

The inherited list is not an individually justified progression. A parametric plane needs the vector foundation directly; calculus, orientation, and angle calculation are redundant or unrelated direct prerequisites.

Determining and validating a normal vector relies directly on the dot product as an orthogonality criterion. The focused 9460 goal is semantically more precise than the inherited calculus, orientation, vector, and angle-calculation list; its own prerequisite retains the vector foundation transitively.

The integrated orientation goal explicitly uses point tests. The atomic point-test goal is therefore the precise direct prerequisite; its own dependency retains coordinate form transitively without a duplicate edge.

finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Geraden im Raum mithilfe eines Stützvektors und eines Richtungsvektors in Parameterform angeben und aus punktweisen Beschreibungen geeignete Vektorgleichungen aufstellen.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can state lines in space using a position vector and a direction vector in parametric form and set up suitable vector equations from point-wise descriptions.

decisions.rationale: Round A's source-gap and atomicity premises are contradicted by exact legacy mappings, provenance, and the current atomic ledger. The goal remains distinct from the line-and-segment extension; only its demonstrably foreign direct prerequisites are removed.

finalText.titleDe: Geraden und Strecken im Raum in Parameterform darstellen und Parameter deuten
finalText.titleEn: Represent lines and segments in space parametrically and interpret parameters
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Geraden und Strecken im Raum aus zwei verschiedenen Punkten parametrisch darstellen, dabei für Geraden den gesamten reellen Parameterbereich und für Strecken einen passenden begrenzten Parameterbereich festlegen sowie Parameterwerte im Kontext deuten.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can parametrically represent lines and segments in space from two distinct points, use the full real parameter range for lines and an appropriate bounded parameter interval for segments, and interpret parameter values in context.

decisions.rationale: The revision makes the mathematically decisive distinction between an unbounded line and a bounded segment explicit without prescribing only one equivalent parametrization.

finalText.titleDe: Ebenen in Parameterform angeben und interpretieren
finalText.titleEn: State and interpret planes in parametric form
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann eine Ebene durch einen Stützpunkt und zwei linear unabhängige Spannvektoren in Parameterform angeben, den Stützpunkt und die Spannvektoren geometrisch deuten und die Zugehörigkeit von Punkten prüfen.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can represent a plane parametrically using a base point and two linearly independent spanning vectors, interpret the base point and spanning vectors geometrically, and test whether points lie on the plane.

decisions.rationale: Linear independence is the missing validity condition that distinguishes a plane from a degenerate line or point representation.

Both reviews support the current competency, and Round B captures the non-uniqueness and geometric use of normal vectors. Because its inherited direct prerequisites are replaced by the precise orthogonality prerequisite, the goal receives a fresh current-context review before progress.

finalText.titleEn: Set up the point-normal form of a plane
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann aus dem Ortsvektor p eines Ebenenpunkts und einem von null verschiedenen Normalenvektor n die Punkt-Normalen-Form n · (x − p) = 0 aufstellen und als Orthogonalitätsbedingung deuten.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can set up the point-normal form n · (x − p) = 0 from the position vector p of a point on the plane and a nonzero normal vector n and interpret it as an orthogonality condition.

decisions.rationale: The revision replaces the unobservable phrase 'use it' with the defining orthogonality meaning and adds the required nonzero condition.

Both reviews support the current text, and Round B gives the sharper validity condition, solution-set meaning, and scaling invariance for evidence. The direct-successor context changes when the integrated orientation goal is deduplicated through ce491, so this goal receives fresh current-context review before progress.

Round A's claim that the goal lacks an independent source and identity is contradicted by exact Brandenburg and Bavaria mappings and current atomicity. The focused coordinate-to-normal conversion remains distinct from the three-form integration goal, but the conflicting BLOCK is superseded by fresh blind review rather than counted.
Both reviews support the current advanced-course competency. Round B is more complete on normalization, sign, absolute value, and invariance.
The source explicitly requires converting plane representations. Round B best distinguishes the complete three-form conversion from the focused two-form goal and verifies point-set invariance.

Both reviews support the atomic point-membership test, and Round A states the equivalence and residual criterion more clearly in both languages. The integrated orientation goal becomes a new direct successor, so this goal receives fresh current-context review before progress.

finalText.titleEn: Determine a plane equation from geometric conditions
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann aus drei nicht kollinearen Punkten, einem Ebenenpunkt und einem von null verschiedenen Normalenvektor oder einem Ebenenpunkt und zwei linear unabhängigen Spannvektoren eine passende Ebenengleichung bestimmen.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can determine a suitable plane equation from three noncollinear points, from a point on the plane and a nonzero normal vector, or from a point on the plane and two linearly independent spanning vectors.

decisions.rationale: The revision states the nondegeneracy conditions required for each of the three existing construction routes without adding a new competence.

finalText.titleDe: Parallelogramme und Dreiecke in Parameterform darstellen
finalText.titleEn: Represent Parallelograms and Triangles in Parametric Form
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann aus den Eckpunkten passende Spannvektoren bestimmen, Parallelogramme durch x = a + su + tv mit 0 ≤ s,t ≤ 1 und Dreiecke mit s,t ≥ 0 und s + t ≤ 1 parametrisch darstellen und die begrenzten Punktmengen geometrisch deuten.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can determine suitable spanning vectors from the vertices, parametrically represent parallelograms by x = a + su + tv with 0 ≤ s,t ≤ 1 and triangles with s,t ≥ 0 and s + t ≤ 1, and interpret the bounded point sets geometrically.

decisions.rationale: The parameter constraints are essential: without them the same affine expression describes the entire supporting plane rather than the bounded shapes.

finalText.titleDe: Koordinatenformen von Ebenen zur Orientierung im Raum nutzen
finalText.titleEn: Use coordinate forms of planes for orientation in space
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann aus der Koordinatenform einer Ebene Achsenschnittpunkte und die Richtung des Normalenvektors bestimmen, die Zugehörigkeit gegebener Punkte prüfen und diese Informationen zu einer begründeten räumlichen Lagebeschreibung der Ebene zusammenführen.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can determine a plane's axis intercepts and normal direction from its coordinate form, test whether given points lie on the plane, and combine these results into a reasoned spatial description of the plane's position.

decisions.rationale: The integrated orientation scope is independently source-backed and should not be split. The revision turns the former list into a coherent synthesis performance, while the existing atomic point-test and coordinate-form goals remain prerequisites.
Both reviews support the current modeling-and-solving competency. Round B better distinguishes rank, consistency, and free variables from mere equation counting.

finalText.titleEn: Geometrically interpret solution sets of linear systems
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die Lösungsmenge eines linearen Gleichungssystems in einer analytisch-geometrischen Situation im Raum als Schnittmenge der durch seine Gleichungen beschriebenen Punktmengen deuten und sie anhand von Konsistenz und Anzahl freier Variablen als leere Menge, Punkt, Gerade, Ebene oder ganzen Raum einordnen.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can interpret the solution set of a linear system in a three-dimensional analytic-geometry situation as the intersection of the point sets described by its equations and classify it, based on consistency and the number of free variables, as the empty set, a point, a line, a plane, or all of space.

decisions.rationale: The revision removes the former mixture of geometric type and solution cardinality and ties the classification to consistency and dimension.
Both reviews support the current point-test competence. Round B makes the supporting-line versus bounded-segment distinction most explicit.
Both reviews support the current trace-point competence. Round A preserves the intrinsic empty and contained-line cases without expanding the canonical wording.
Both reviews support the current advanced-course competence. Round A has the cleaner bilingual distinction between family and running parameter.
Both reviews support the current advanced-course competence. Round B most clearly distinguishes family parameters, spatial variables, degeneracy, and representational scaling.
